tips.text: Cast Flash Frost, then hit with Frostbite right after; Frostbite deals far more damage to enemies the ice has chilled.
Detonate Flash Frost early when the enemy is close, so they are stunned. Otherwise the ice only bursts at the end of its range.
Aim Flash Frost down a line of enemies. The ice keeps flying after it hits someone, so it can catch the enemy behind a minion.
Put Crystallize between you and a melee enemy to block their path. Enemies standing on the wall's line get pushed to its sides.
Turn on Glacial Storm only when enemies will stay inside it, and turn it off when the fight ends. It drains your mana quickly.
Let Glacial Storm grow to full size before you count on it. Fully formed, it hits much harder and slows more.
Play aggressively early. Your egg from Rebirth is hard to kill in the early game, so you can trade more boldly.
Stay in the storm's range. Glacial Storm switches off if you walk too far from it or get hit by crowd control.

combos.name: Early Flash Frost detonation
combos.when: When the ice chunk is passing through or next to an enemy well before its max range.
combos.text: Recast Flash Frost as the ice reaches the target to stun them now. Waiting for max range lets them walk out of the stun.

combos.name: Wall-trap stun
combos.when: When an enemy is about to retreat or walk toward you and you want to hold them in place.
combos.text: Place Crystallize behind or in front of them to block their path, then land Flash Frost and recast it to stun. The wall limits their escape routes.

tips.text: Cast Flash Frost, then hit Frostbite right after it lands; Frostbite deals far more damage to a Chilled enemy.
Recast Flash Frost when the ice is on top of an enemy to stun them. Otherwise it only stuns at the end of its range.
Aim Flash Frost down a line of minions. The ice keeps flying after it hits something, so it can still reach the enemy champion.
Use Crystallize to block an enemy's path when they chase you, or to cut off their retreat. Units touching the wall are pushed away from it.
Turn on Glacial Storm only when enemies will stay in it, and turn it off when the fight ends. It drains your mana quickly.
Let Glacial Storm grow to full size before you count on it. Once formed it hits much harder and slows more.
Trade aggressively early. If you die, Rebirth turns you into an egg that is hard to kill in lane.
Stay in the egg's safety only if no enemy can reach it. While you are an egg you can't act, so stay away from enemies who can finish it.

combos.name: Early Flash Frost detonation
combos.when: When an enemy is close or walking into the ice and you want the stun sooner than max range.
combos.text: Recast Flash Frost as the ice passes through or beside the target. It stuns right away instead of waiting for the end of its range, so it is harder to dodge.

tips.text: Fire Flash Frost down a lane of enemies, then recast it early when it reaches the enemy so they are stunned. Hold it for when they cannot step out of the way.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite on a chilled enemy. It does much more damage than on an enemy that was not hit.
Use Crystallize to block a path. An enemy diving at you or your carry must walk around it, and it pushes enemies away from the wall.
Turn on Glacial Storm only when enemies are standing in it, then switch it off. It drains mana fast, and leaving its range turns it off.
Play aggressively early. Enemies struggle to kill her egg, so Rebirth lets you take a risky trade once.
Hold Glacial Storm for fights near a wall or choke point, where enemies stay slowed in the storm while you poke them.

combos.name: Early Flash Frost detonation
combos.when: When an enemy is close or you want the stun to land on a target before the ice reaches max range.
combos.text: Recast Flash Frost as the ice reaches the enemy so it bursts on them. The stun then lands without waiting for max range, and the slow gets refreshed.

tips.text: Put Crystallize between you and Aatrox when he closes in. It blocks his path and knocks him off the wall.
Hit Aatrox with Flash Frost, then follow with Frostbite right away. Frostbite deals double damage to him while he is chilled.
Stay out of range of Infernal Chains and sidestep The Darkin Blade. Its hit zones are telegraphed, so keep moving.
Hold Flash Frost for when Aatrox dashes in or stands still to cast. Detonate it early to stun him when he is close.
Turn on Glacial Storm when Aatrox stands in a choke point or fights near minions. Switch it off when he leaves, to save mana.
Put Crystallize between you and Briar before she gets close; the wall is solid ground she has to walk around instead of leaping straight in.
Hit Briar with Flash Frost, then Frostbite her right after; Frostbite hits much harder on a target the ice has chilled.
Stay at long range and poke with Flash Frost; Briar has to close the gap, and a slowed Briar is easier to hit.
When Briar is stuck on you in her frenzy, turn on Glacial Storm under her and walk back; she must chase you through the damage.
Be careful with your mana in Glacial Storm; it drains fast, so turn it off when Briar is not in it.
Put Crystallize between you and Darius when he walks up; he cannot walk through it, so he cannot easily reach you.
Fire Flash Frost at him as he approaches; it slows him and stuns if the ice bursts on him.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite; it hits much harder on a chilled enemy.
Stay at long range and poke him. He is strongest once he gets to hit you, so do not let him reach you.
Watch for Apprehend. It pulls you to him, so keep your distance when it is ready and use Glacial Storm to slow him if he does get close.
Keep Crystallize ready as a wall between you and Fiora; it knocks her away from it and blocks her path when she runs at you.
Don't throw Flash Frost or Crystallize at Fiora while Riposte is up. She blocks the stun and can stun you back, so bait it out first.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite on a Chilled Fiora; it hits much harder, so you can trade well from range.
Stay back from Fiora. Lunge closes the gap quickly, so keep Flash Frost or Crystallize ready for when she dashes in.
Save mana by using Glacial Storm only when Fiora is standing in it or chasing you. It drains mana fast.
Save Crystallize for when Gangplank walks up to a keg or tries to close in. The wall blocks his path and pushes him away from it.
Fire Flash Frost at Gangplank, then hit him with Frostbite. It deals double damage against a target Flash Frost has chilled.
Stay out of his keg range and keep him slowed with Glacial Storm when he steps forward to attack a keg. Staying far back makes his keg combos harder.
Do not rely on Flash Frost's stun to answer his Remove Scurvy, since it clears stuns. Bait it out, then trade.
Keep your distance and poke him from range. His Parrrley has short range, so he has to come to you.
Keep Garen at range with Flash Frost; the slow makes it hard for him to reach you, and the ice keeps going through minions.
Fire Frostbite right after Flash Frost hits; it hits much harder on a chilled Garen.
Put Crystallize between you and Garen when he runs at you; the wall blocks his path and buys time for your spells.
Garen's Decisive Strike removes slows and speeds him up, so do not rely on slows to hold him once he uses it.
Stay back when Decisive Strike is ready; if he reaches you, it silences you and you cannot cast.
Hit Garen with Glacial Storm while he is walking up to you, and stop it if he gets close, so you do not waste mana.
Aim Flash Frost at Jayce's path and recast to stun him. Follow with Frostbite, which hits much harder on an enemy hit by the ice.
Place Crystallize in front of Jayce as he comes in. Units are knocked away from the wall, which can break up his approach.
Stay at long range and keep Flash Frost ready. Jayce's Shock Blast hits hard, so do not stand in a straight line with him.
Turn on Glacial Storm when Jayce is stuck in melee or leaping into you. It slows him and keeps damaging him.
Play aggressively while your Rebirth is available. It is hard for Jayce to finish you off early.
Aim Flash Frost at K'Sante as he walks up to trade, then follow with Frostbite while he is chilled; it hits much harder.
Keep Glacial Storm on the lane and stay at range; it slows K'Sante and chips at him when he wants to close the gap.
Hold Crystallize for when K'Sante charges Path Maker; a wall in his path stops the dash short.
Stay out of his Ntofo Strikes range. Two hits make the next one pull and stun you, so do not stand close after he lands one.
Do not fight him near walls once he has level 6. All Out can throw you through terrain for extra damage.
When he goes All Out he is much squishier; chill him and burst him with Frostbite.
Hit Malphite with Flash Frost, then follow with Frostbite right away; it hits much harder on a target the ice has chilled.
Stay out of his range and poke him; Malphite has to walk up to Seismic Shard range to trade and has little else to reach you.
Drop Crystallize between you and Malphite when he comes in; his Unstoppable Force can't be stopped by it, so keep distance rather than relying on the wall.
Stay clear of him at level 6; Unstoppable Force knocks you up and Malphite gets free hits on you.
Use Glacial Storm on him while he is slowed and trying to close the gap; do not stand inside his Ground Slam range.
Aim Flash Frost at him as he walks up, then follow with Frostbite; it hits much harder on a target the ice has chilled.
Stay out of melee range. Once Darkness Rise is active, his aura hurts anyone standing next to him.
Do not stand in a straight line from him. Death's Grasp pulls you toward him, right into his aura.
Keep Glacial Storm on him while he closes in. It leaves him slowed and wears down his shield.
Put Crystallize between you when he charges. It blocks his path and buys time for your spells.
Hit Rumble with Flash Frost, then use Frostbite right away; it deals far more damage to an enemy the ice has chilled.
Hold Flash Frost until Rumble walks up to hit minions. If you recast it as it reaches him, he is stunned.
Rumble is silenced while he overheats. Hit him with everything you have then, because he cannot answer with spells.
Place Crystallize between you and Rumble to stop him closing in on you. Walls also cut off his path when he tries to chase.
Stay out of the way of The Equalizer, because its fire slows you and hurts. Do not stand in it; step out, or put Crystallize between you and Rumble.
Keep your distance from Rumble. His Flamespitter has short range, and his Electro Harpoon is easy to sidestep if you watch for it.
Keep Flash Frost aimed at Sion's path. A hit slows him and makes Frostbite deal much more.
Stay out of Decimating Smash range when Sion starts charging. A long charge stuns you for a long time.
Put Crystallize between you and Sion when he closes in. It blocks his movement.
Poke Sion from range with Frostbite and Glacial Storm. He has little ranged damage besides Roar of the Slayer.
Don't finish Sion in melee range. Glory in Death makes him hit very fast after dying, so back away.
Fire Flash Frost at Teemo, then hit him with Frostbite while he is chilled for extra damage.
Do not stand in Glacial Storm too long near his mushrooms; he can hide and poke you with Toxic Shot. Check bushes for Noxious Trap first.
Do not walk into bushes without checking them. Teemo can hide there unseen and surprise you with Blinding Dart.
Block his approach with Crystallize when he runs at you, and punish him with Flash Frost while he is stuck behind it.
Aim Flash Frost at Vayne when she walks up to attack, then follow with Frostbite for big damage while she is chilled.
Stay away from walls when Vayne has Condemn up. A wall behind you means a stun and heavy damage.
Vayne is fragile, so push her back with Glacial Storm and Frostbite to make her play cautiously.
Fire Flash Frost down the line she tumbles along, since it keeps flying and hits her wherever she lands.
Fight with your egg up. If Vayne kills you early, Rebirth can still save you if the egg survives.
Fire Flash Frost down the lane when Yone walks up to the wave; it slows him and a late recast stuns him.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite while he is chilled; it hits much harder against him then.
Put Crystallize between you and Yone when he threatens to dash in. It blocks his path and pushes him aside.
Stay out of Mortal Steel range and watch for two hits on anything. The third cast dashes and knocks you up.
Turn on Glacial Storm on him when he is stuck in a fight; it keeps him slowed while he tries to reach you.
Toggle Glacial Storm off when he is gone. It drains a lot of Mana and you will run dry.
Put Crystallize between you and Ahri's Charm line; her kiss ends at the first unit it hits, so a wall can stop it.
Open with Flash Frost, then hit Frostbite right after; it deals extra damage to chilled enemies.
Stay far back and sidestep Charm; Anivia's lane is much safer when Ahri has no way to reach you.
Hold Glacial Storm for when Ahri stands in a spot to farm or fight; she is slowed and takes steady damage.
Be careful trading when Ahri's Spirit Rush is ready; she can dash on you after a trade. Play more boldly while it is on cooldown.
Save Crystallize for when Akali dashes in with Perfect Execution or Shuriken Flip; the wall can block her path and knock her away.
Throw Flash Frost along her path when she walks up to trade; it slows her, and Frostbite then hits for double damage.
Keep Glacial Storm on her when she stands in smoke; it still hits her and slows her down.
Stay far back and keep Flash Frost ready; Akali has to commit to get close, and the stun can punish her.
Aim Flash Frost at Akshan when he walks up to trade; his Avengerang and Heroic Swing don't help him dodge well once he commits.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite on a chilled Akshan; the hit does double damage.
Recast Flash Frost early when Akshan is in the ice's path so he is stunned instead of waiting for max range.
Akshan can vanish with Going Rogue, so keep Glacial Storm on the ground where he was; its slow leaves a trail that shows him even when stealthed.
Akshan's Heroic Swing hooks onto terrain, not onto your Crystallize wall. Save the wall for blocking his path when he rushes you.
Pair Flash Frost with Frostbite. Frostbite hits much harder on enemies the ice has chilled.
Watch Annie's Pyromania counter. When it is lit, stay out of her range, because her next spell stuns.
Put Crystallize between you and Annie when she walks up. It blocks her path while you keep poking.
Stay away from Tibbers after Annie summons him; he burns everything near him. Slow him down with Glacial Storm.
Put Crystallize between you and Aurelion Sol when he flies in with Astral Flight; the wall blocks his path and knocks him aside.
Hit him with Flash Frost, then follow with Frostbite while he is still chilled for much bigger damage.
Stay out of the black hole from Singularity; it drags you in, so step away early and do not fight inside it.
Break the Breath of Light beam by walking out of its line or putting up Crystallize, so he cannot keep burning you.
Move away from the marked ground when Falling Star is cast; it lands after a delay and stuns whoever is still there.
Keep Glacial Storm on him when he steps in to trade; it slows him and wears him down.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane when Aurora walks up to the wave, then follow with Frostbite for the doubled damage on a chilled target.
Keep your distance and dodge Twofold Hex sideways; it is a thin bolt that Aurora can aim well from long range.
Be ready to hit her when she vanishes with Across the Veil; her invisibility is brief, so aim Flash Frost where she is heading.
Crystallize can block her path when she dives in with Between Worlds; her rift borders slow you if you cross them, so fight from outside it.
Aurora heals from exorcised spirits, so avoid trading little pokes with her that stack up her passive; make your trades count.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane at Azir; it slows him as it flies and stuns him if you let it reach the end of its range.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite while he is still chilled, because it hits much harder against a chilled enemy.
Azir's soldiers are what hurt you. Stay out of their reach and trade when they are far from you.
Put Crystallize between you and Azir when he tries to dash in or ult. The wall is solid terrain and stops enemies walking through.
Watch your mana with Glacial Storm. Switch it on only when Azir is standing in it, and switch it off when he leaves.
Play aggressively early. Rebirth makes it hard for Azir to finish you off, so you can take trades.
Hold Crystallize between you and Brand when he lines up Sear; the wall blocks his walking path, and he has to aim around it.
Sidestep Sear. It only turns into a stun if he has already set you ablaze with another spell, so stay out of his other spells first.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite right away; it hits much harder on a target the ice just hit.
Use Glacial Storm to slow Brand when he is trying to line up spells, and step out of Pillar of Flame, which lands after a short delay.
Play aggressively early, while your egg is hard to kill. Brand can't easily finish you off in a trade.
Put Crystallize between you and Briar when she jumps in; it blocks her path and she cannot cross the wall while it lasts.
Hit Briar with Flash Frost, then use Frostbite right away; it hits much harder on a chilled target.
Keep Glacial Storm on the ground where Briar must run to reach you; it slows her and hurts her all the way in.
Stay at long range and poke with Flash Frost; Briar has to close the gap, and Flash Frost is easier to dodge up close, so keep your distance.
Save the Flash Frost recast for when Briar is on top of you; the stun gives you time to back away.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane when Cassiopeia walks up to last-hit; it passes through units, so one cast can hit her and the minions.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite right away; it deals extra damage to a target the ice has chilled.
Stay out of Noxious Blast range and sidestep it. It lands after a short delay, so walk out of the circle once it appears.
Keep your distance when Cassiopeia has you poisoned; Twin Fang hurts a lot then. Back out of range of it.
Once you reach level 6, keep Glacial Storm on her when she stands in the lane. It slows her and she cannot easily walk out.
Do not run straight at Cassiopeia facing her when Petrifying Gaze is ready, or you will be stunned. Stay out of its range.
Aim Flash Frost at Diana before she closes in; she is slowed, and a recast near her stuns.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite on a chilled Diana; it hits much harder.
Put Crystallize between you and Diana when she looks to dash in; it blocks movement.
Turn on Glacial Storm on yourself as Diana dives; it slows her and hurts while she stays in it.
Stay back from Diana after level 6, because Moonfall pulls you in and slows you.
Play aggressively early; Diana needs to get close to you, and your egg is hard to kill.
Fire Flash Frost at Ekko, then hit him with Frostbite while he is chilled; it deals far more damage that way.
Ekko wants to dive onto you. Keep Crystallize ready to put a wall between you and him when he closes in.
Stay out of Ekko's Parallel Convergence circle. Watch for the image he leaves on cast and walk away before it arms.
Ekko is much weaker with Chronobreak down, so trade harder then. When it is up, do not chase him into a fight, because he can rewind away.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane so it slows Ekko as he walks up. Keep Glacial Storm for fights where he stays in it.
Fire Flash Frost down the lane when Ezreal steps up to hit minions, then follow with Frostbite for double damage on the chilled target.
Ezreal is fragile and relies on aiming, so stay slightly out of his range and make him come to you.
Put Crystallize in the path of his Mystic Shot, since projectiles are blocked by it. It also gives you time to line up Flash Frost.
Do not walk into the open after Ezreal uses Arcane Shift. He can blink away from Glacial Storm, so use it when he is stuck fighting or pushed up.
Trade aggressively while your egg is up, since Rebirth lets you survive a fight you would otherwise lose.
Hold Crystallize until Fizz commits to Playful or Urchin Strike; the wall only lasts a short while and he can simply walk around it.
Hit Fizz with Flash Frost, then Frostbite him right away for much more damage.
Fizz is untargetable during Playful, so don't waste Frostbite or Flash Frost on him then. Wait until he lands.
Keep Glacial Storm on him when he dives; it slows him and keeps hurting as he tries to trade.
Stay far from Fizz so Urchin Strike can't reach you. Poke him with Flash Frost from range.
Play carefully when Chum the Waters is ready. Stay away from the lure's path, since a far hit knocks you up.
Keep Frostbite for targets chilled by Flash Frost; it does double damage.
Put Crystallize between you and Galio when he walks up; his Justice Punch dash stops on terrain.
Stay far from Galio and aim Flash Frost at him early; he gets slowed when he charges Shield of Durand.
Watch for Galio's Hero's Entrance landing on your lane at level 6; stay clear of the impact.
Fire Flash Frost down the lane, then hit Frostbite right after; it deals extra damage to Chilled enemies.
Use Crystallize to block the path of Hwei's Gaze of the Abyss or his Grim Visage if the wall is in front of you.
Step in on Hwei after he casts a Torment spell; he is open to being rushed down, so lean in with Frostbite.
Keep Glacial Storm on only while enemies stand inside it; it drains your mana fast.
Put Crystallize between you and Irelia when she walks up. It blocks her path, and Bladesurge needs a target to reach you.
Hit Irelia with Flash Frost, then use Frostbite right away. It does double damage on a target the ice has chilled.
Keep your distance and poke her. She has to close the gap, and Flash Frost slows her as she does.
Don't burn Flash Frost or Frostbite on Irelia while she is charging Defiant Dance. She takes much less damage and nothing interrupts it.
Stay away from minion waves when she is near. Bladesurge lets her jump between minions to reach you.
Turn on Glacial Storm on top of her when she dives in. It slows her and deals steady damage, but you can't cast it while stunned.
Use Frostbite right after Flash Frost hits; chilled enemies take far more damage from it.
Kassadin takes reduced magic damage, so wait for a Flash Frost that lands before you spend Frostbite on him.
Slow him with Flash Frost and Glacial Storm before level 6, while Riftwalk is on a long cooldown and he can't easily dodge or close in.
Kassadin ignores unit collision and blinks with Riftwalk, so Crystallize won't reliably wall him off. Use it to protect yourself or split a fight.
Stay out of Null Sphere range and keep your distance; it also interrupts your Glacial Storm channel if it hits you.
Hold Flash Frost for when he blinks in with Riftwalk; its stun then punishes him up close.
Put Crystallize between you and Katarina when she jumps in; the wall blocks her walking path, and Shunpo is still her way past it.
Fire Flash Frost at Katarina, then hit her with Frostbite while she is chilled for much bigger damage.
Hold Flash Frost until she commits to a jump, then use it to get her stunned at the end of its range or when you detonate it early.
Turn on Glacial Storm on yourself when she dives. It slows her and hurts her, but stay out of her reach while it runs.
Katarina can kill your egg once Rebirth triggers, so don't trade at low health when she has her abilities ready.
Aim Flash Frost at where LeBlanc will dash, and detonate it early if she gets close. A stun gives you time to blast her.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite; it deals double damage to chilled enemies.
Stun LeBlanc before she can return with Distortion, so she is stuck where you hit her.
Stay back from LeBlanc's range, since Ethereal Chains roots if you stay tethered. Walk out of the tether or use Crystallize to cut her off.
Use Glacial Storm only when you have mana for it, and play aggressively once Rebirth is up, since the egg is hard to kill early.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane and recast it when Lissandra is close to stun her, then hit her with Frostbite for the bigger damage.
Stay out of Ring of Frost range. If it roots you, Lissandra can follow up with Ice Shard and Glacial Path.
Lissandra can blink through walls with Glacial Path. Don't count on Crystallize to keep her out.
Stand behind your minions so Ice Shard hits them first. It only slows the first enemy it hits.
Use Glacial Storm to zone her from the minion wave. Stop it when she walks out of the storm.
Be careful when you fight near level 6. Frozen Tomb can stun you, and you can still be killed before Rebirth helps.
Put Crystallize between you and Lux when she lines up Light Binding; the wall blocks movement, so use it to stay out of her range.
Hit Lux with Flash Frost, then use Frostbite right away; it does far more damage to a chilled target.
Stand back from Lux so you can sidestep Light Binding; if it lands you are rooted and easy to hit.
Fight when Rebirth is ready; you can be more aggressive because it is hard for Lux to finish your egg.
Stay out of Lucent Singularity's area; it slows you, and the blast hurts.
Aim Flash Frost at Malzahar when he walks up to hit minions; it slows him, and the early recast stuns him if he is close.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite right away; it hits much harder on a chilled target.
Hit Malzahar while his Void Shift is down. It cuts the damage he takes while it is up, so poke him after it breaks.
Stay out of the Call of the Void zone and keep your distance from the portals; being silenced stops you from casting your combo.
Do not stand near minions marked by Malefic Visions; when they die it spreads to you.
Gank-proof yourself: if Nether Grasp lands on you, your egg from Rebirth cannot save you from the hold.
Wait until Mel has used Rebuttal before you throw Flash Frost; it destroys projectiles that touch it.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite while they are still chilled; it hits much harder against a chilled target.
Back off when Mel's Overwhelm stacks build up and your health is low; her next hit can finish you.
Mel's Solar Snare can catch you from far away. Keep your distance and stay out of a straight line with her.
Put Crystallize between you and Mel to block her walking up, and use the time to poke her.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane as Naafiri closes in; she is slowed, and the recast stuns her if she is still near the ice.
Follow a Flash Frost hit with Frostbite right away; it deals much more damage to a chilled target.
Put Crystallize between you and Naafiri when she tries to reach you. The wall blocks movement and pushes units aside.
Turn on Glacial Storm on the spot where she will land after her dash; it slows her while she is stuck on you.
Keep your distance and poke with Frostbite while Naafiri's dashes are on cooldown. She has to come to you.
Aim Flash Frost at Orianna when she walks up to hit minions; she is slowed, and Frostbite then hits much harder.
Stay far back so you can dodge Command: Attack, and walk sideways when the Ball is near you.
Look where the Ball is. Orianna's spells only hit around it, so stand outside that area when you trade.
Fight with Glacial Storm only when you can afford the mana; it drains quickly, so turn it off when she backs away.
Do not stand close to Orianna at level 6; Command: Shockwave pulls you in and stuns you. Keep your distance from the Ball.
Play aggressively early, since Rebirth makes your egg hard to kill.
Hit Qiyana with Flash Frost, then follow with Frostbite right away; it deals double damage to a target the ice has chilled.
Keep your distance when Qiyana dashes at you with Audacity. Slow her with Glacial Storm and poke her with Frostbite instead of standing next to her.
Save Flash Frost for when Qiyana commits to a dash. Its stun on detonation stops her from finishing the trade.
Qiyana can burst you down, so fight near river and brush less. Rebirth gives you a second chance if she kills you, so stay aggressive early.
Crystallize can be a barrier between you and Qiyana. Place the wall where she wants to dash or walk, but do not count on it stopping her dash.
Hit Ryze with Flash Frost, then use Frostbite right away. It does much more damage to a chilled target.
Ryze has to stay in range to cast, so keep Flash Frost aimed at the spot he walks to. Detonate it early if he steps close.
Use Crystallize to block him when he dashes in or to cut off his escape. It knocks units away from the wall.
Stay away when Ryze has Flux on you. Rune Prison then roots you and Overload hits harder, so keep your distance.
If Ryze opens Realm Warp, stun him with Flash Frost to cancel the portal before his team arrives.
Aim Flash Frost at Sylas when he walks up to trade, then follow with Frostbite; it hits much harder on enemies the ice has chilled.
Put Crystallize between you and Sylas when he looks to dash in; the wall blocks movement and can break his approach.
Keep your distance from Sylas. Abduct pulls him to the first enemy it hits, so stay out of its reach.
Don't rely on Sylas being low before you commit; Kingslayer heals him back up when he hits you, so finish him fast.
Use Flash Frost's stun at the end of its range or recast it early when Sylas is close, so he is stunned and can't dash around.
Cast Frostbite on enemies already hit by Flash Frost; it deals far more damage against them.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane when Syndra steps up to the wave. It is slow and wide, so she can sidestep it, but it keeps flying through minions.
Stay out of Scatter the Weak range when her Dark Spheres are on the ground. A pushed sphere stuns you.
Punish Syndra right after she uses Scatter the Weak. It has a long cooldown, so she can't easily push you away.
Put Crystallize between you and her Dark Sphere or Force of Will throw to block your path.
Be careful when Syndra has many spheres out at level 6. Unleashed Power hits hard and can finish you off, so stay healthy.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane and recast it early when Taliyah is next to the ice; she dodges the long, narrow chunk easily when it flies the full way.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite while she is chilled; it hits far harder than on its own.
Put Crystallize between you and Taliyah when she lines up Seismic Shove; she then cannot reach you easily.
Stay out of the stones of Unraveled Earth; if you are knocked or dashed through them you get stunned.
Step sideways when Taliyah casts Threaded Volley; it flies in a fixed direction.
Do not run Glacial Storm for long early; it drains your mana fast. Save it for when she is stuck in it.
Put Crystallize between you and Talon when he looks to jump in; the wall blocks his walking path and knocks units away from it.
Hit Talon with Flash Frost, then follow with Frostbite right away; it deals extra damage to a Chilled target.
Keep Flash Frost ready for when Talon dives onto you; the stun at the end buys time to fight back.
Talon can vanish with Shadow Assault and roam, so call your team when he disappears from lane. Glacial Storm still leaves a slow trail you can see.
Early on, poke Talon with Frostbite and Flash Frost from range, and stay far enough back that he cannot reach you.
Hit Twisted Fate with Flash Frost, then use Frostbite right away; it hits much harder on enemies who are chilled.
Do not let Twisted Fate hit you with an enhanced attack. The Gold Card stuns you, so keep your distance when he is shuffling cards.
Put Crystallize between you and him when he lines up an attack. It blocks movement, so he cannot walk straight to you.
Watch for Destiny. It means a gank or a jump is coming, so back toward safety.
Turn on Glacial Storm only when he is stuck in it or cannot dodge. It drains your mana quickly, and your wave is safer when you are not out of mana.
Cast Crystallize across the path of Veigar's Dark Matter fights and use it to cut off his approach; the wall blocks movement for a few seconds.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite right away; Veigar is chilled, so Frostbite hits much harder.
Watch the ground for Dark Matter's warning circle and step out of it; it lands after a short delay.
Stay outside Event Horizon's edge. Only enemies who touch the edge get stunned, so walk around it rather than through it.
Veigar is fragile, so push him back with Glacial Storm when he steps up to last-hit; it slows him and hurts over time.
Veigar grows stronger each time he hits you, so play safe and dodge his spells rather than trading blindly.
Keep Crystallize ready for when Vex wants to walk up; the wall knocks her away from it and blocks her path.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite right away; it hits for double on enemies the ice has hit.
Stay at long range and aim Flash Frost down the lane. Vex has to come close to use Personal Space, so she is easy to slow and punish when she does.
Do not dash or blink next to Vex. Her Doom 'n Gloom marks dashers for bonus damage, so Anivia should keep her distance and rely on her spells.
Vex can dive onto you with Shadow Surge once she has a mark on you. Hold Crystallize to cut the dash off, and stay near your wave and your jungler.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane to slow Viktor, then follow with Frostbite, which hits much harder against a chilled target.
Stay outside his short Hextech Ray range and trade with long-range Flash Frost instead.
Do not stand in Gravity Field after it lands. Walk out before it stuns you.
Use Crystallize to block the path when Viktor walks up, so he cannot get close for his trades.
Fight where Rebirth can protect you. If you die, he must kill your egg, and that is hard early.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane when Vladimir walks up for last-hits, then follow with Frostbite for double damage.
Do not use Frostbite right after Vladimir casts Sanguine Pool; you cannot target him while he is in it. Wait until he comes out.
Put Crystallize between you and Vladimir to stop him walking onto you. It blocks him from closing in to trade.
Kill Vladimir before Hemoplague bursts, since it heals him. Stay out of its area.
Do not trade into a charged Tides of Blood; it slows you. Stay outside its short range.
Do not rely on your egg to win a fight in lane. Vladimir's Transfusion and Sanguine Pool help him heal and stay on it.
Put Crystallize between you and Xerath when he charges Arcanopulse or aims Shocking Orb; the wall stops his orb from reaching you.
Hit Xerath with Flash Frost, then use Frostbite right away; it does far more damage to him while he is chilled.
Punish Xerath while he is charging Arcanopulse; he is slowed and cannot attack or cast, so he is easy to hit with Flash Frost.
Stay out of Xerath's range and keep dodging Shocking Orb; one hit leaves you stunned and open to his follow-up.
Turn on Glacial Storm once Xerath is slowed or stunned in a fight; it keeps hurting him while he stays inside.
Rebirth lets you trade aggressively early, since the egg is hard to kill. Walk up on Xerath once Rite of the Arcane is down.
Hit Xin Zhao with Flash Frost, then Frostbite him; Frostbite hits much harder on a chilled target.
Put Crystallize in his path as he charges in; it blocks his movement and buys you time.
Keep your distance; his Three Talon Strike needs him next to you to knock you up and cut his cooldowns.
Glacial Storm slows him as he closes in; start it early so it is fully formed when he arrives.
At level 6 he can sweep you away with Crescent Guard; don't stand alone against his all-in.
Put Crystallize in front of Yasuo when he dashes at you; Sweeping Blade needs a target, and the wall stops his path and shoves him aside.
Do not rely on Flash Frost when Wind Wall is up; it blocks the ice and wastes your cooldown. Wait for the wall to drop, then throw it.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite while he is chilled; it hits much harder against enemies the ice just touched.
Frostbite is also blocked by Wind Wall, so wait for the wall to end before using it on him.
Keep Glacial Storm on him when he wants to trade up close; he stays slowed and takes steady damage. Stop it when your mana runs low.
Stay far from him and sidestep Steel Tempest. Its whirlwind knocks you up, so stay out of range once he has two stacks.
Play aggressively early; your egg is hard to kill, so Rebirth lets you take risky trades.
Aim Flash Frost at Yone as he walks up to last-hit; it slows him, and he can't get through the stun if you detonate it on him.
Follow a Flash Frost hit with Frostbite right away; it hits much harder on a target the ice has chilled.
Drop Crystallize in front of Yone when he tries to dash in, so he has to go around it.
Stand in your Glacial Storm when Yone walks into the minion wave; it slows him and keeps him from closing the gap.
Watch for Yone's third Mortal Steel; it knocks you up and lets him dash onto you. Stay at long range and keep Crystallize ready.
Yone's Fate Sealed can pull you in from far away at level 6. Keep your distance and don't stand in a straight line from him.
Put Crystallize between you and Zed when he reaches for you; the wall is solid, so his Living Shadow dash gets blocked or he has to go around.
Hit Zed with Flash Frost, then Frostbite him right away, because Frostbite does much more damage to a chilled target.
Use Flash Frost when Zed walks in close. Recast it early to stun him if he is already near.
Zed has no way to stay out of Glacial Storm once it is fully formed. Keep it on him when he lingers, but toggle it off if you run low on Mana.
Stay far from Zed so his Razor Shuriken falls short. Poke him when his Energy is low.
Zed's Death Mark goes off after a short delay. Rebirth lets you survive a fatal blow, so play more aggressively while it is ready.
Put Crystallize between you and Zoe when she lines up Sleepy Trouble Bubble; the bubble is a projectile, and it can be blocked.
Stay out of Zoe's Paddle Star range. It hurts most from far away, so close the gap or sidestep it.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite. Frostbite hits much harder on a target that Flash Frost just hit.
Punish Zoe when Portal Jump leaves her standing still. She cannot move until she is pulled back, so land Flash Frost on her.
Use Glacial Storm to keep Zoe slowed when she is stuck in place, and use Flash Frost to stun her at the end of its range.
Fire Flash Frost down the lane and follow with Frostbite while the enemy is still chilled; it hits much harder that way.
Stay out of a straight line with Bard and any minion or ally behind you. His Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a second target or a wall.
Do not stand with your back to a wall when Bard has Cosmic Binding ready. It stuns you if it hits terrain after hitting you.
Block a path with Crystallize when Bard tries to walk up and trade or step onto his shrines.
Bard's Tempered Fate can freeze you in place. When you see it coming, step out of the area or wait for it to end before fighting.
Bard can step into the portal made by Magical Journey and so can you. Expect him to roam, and be careful about following.
Stay far back and aim Flash Frost down the lane; Braum's Winter's Bite is his only way to hit you from range, so keep out of its path.
Don't waste Flash Frost into a raised Unbreakable shield; Braum destroys the ice. Wait until the shield drops, or hit him from another angle.
Frostbite hits much harder on a target the ice has chilled, so cast it right after Flash Frost lands.
Keep away from Braum's basic attacks. Four stacks of Concussive Blows stun you, and his partner's attacks add stacks too.
Put Crystallize between you and Braum when he runs at you. It blocks his path and gives you time to back off.
Stand clear of the area Glacial Fissure hits when Braum casts his ultimate. Its long cast time gives you room to step out.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite while the enemy is still chilled; Frostbite hits much harder against a chilled target.
Karma's Inner Flame stops at the first enemy it hits. Stay behind minions so it cannot reach you.
Karma's Focused Resolve roots only if the tether stays unbroken. Step out of its range, or put up Crystallize between you.
Karma's Mantra cooldown drops each time she hits you. Dodge her spells so she cannot recharge it.
Fire Flash Frost down the lane when Karma's ally shields with Inspire is not up; her shield soaks the damage.
Stay far back from Leona and keep Crystallize ready; a wall across her path stops her from walking up to you.
Hit Leona with Flash Frost as she closes in; she is slowed, and Frostbite then hits her much harder.
Do not stand at the edge of Zenith Blade range, since she dashes to you and roots you for a moment. Step out of its line early.
When Leona raises Eclipse, back off instead of trading; her armor is up and her blast only hits those close to her.
Zenith Blade has a slow-moving dash, so use Flash Frost to end her engage with a stun, and then run away.
Fight from a distance with Glacial Storm when she is trapped behind your wall, but watch your mana.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane and follow with Frostbite while the enemy is still chilled; it hits much harder against chilled targets.
Stay out of Whimsy range when it is ready, since Lulu can polymorph you and leave you unable to act or attack.
Dodge Glitterlance by standing off to the side of the lane. It pierces, so hiding behind minions will not save you.
Use Crystallize to block the path when Lulu or her partner tries to walk up to you.
Be careful when Lulu's ally can be enlarged; Wild Growth knocks you up, so keep your distance at level 6.
Cast Flash Frost, then hit Frostbite right after; chilled enemies take much more damage from it.
Stay out of a straight line with Lux. Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits, so keep minions or allies from lining up in front of you.
Use Crystallize to block the path of Light Binding. It is a projectile, and a wall in front of you can stop it.
Walk out of Lucent Singularity before it goes off. It slows you inside, and the blast slows you for longer.
Keep your distance and push Lux back with Glacial Storm when she steps in. Turn it off when your mana runs low.
Move sideways when you see the red line from Final Spark, especially at low health.
Play aggressively when your egg is up. Rebirth makes it hard for Lux to finish you.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane at range; it passes through minions, so you can hit Milio and his partner behind them.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite while Milio is still chilled, because it then hits much harder.
Use Crystallize to cut Milio off from his partner, since he is weakest when he has no ally near.
Stay out of Ultra Mega Fire Kick's line. Cast Glacial Storm on the lane to slow whoever steps into it.
Stay out of Aqua Prison range; the bubble lands after a short delay, so keep moving and don't stand still while she aims.
Punish Nami right after she misses Aqua Prison, since it has a long cooldown and she has no other way to lock you down.
Fire Flash Frost, then hit Frostbite on the chilled target for much bigger damage.
Back off when an enemy carries Tidecaller's Blessing; it fades fast, so wait it out before you trade.
Use Crystallize to wall off the lane when enemies dash in, and to block the path of an incoming melee ally of Nami.
Sidestep Tidal Wave when you see it coming; it travels slowly.
Stay far back and aim Flash Frost down the lane; Nautilus has to walk into range to do anything, so slow him before he gets close.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite on the chilled target for much bigger damage.
Put Crystallize in front of you when Nautilus looks ready to engage. His Dredge Line can still hit the wall, so don't trust it fully.
Stay out of his Dredge Line range and keep minions between you and him. If he hits you, he drags himself to you and you are stunned.
If Rebirth saves you, your egg can't act. Don't take risky fights near Nautilus, because his ultimate and root can lock you down.
Put Crystallize between you and Pantheon when he leaps in; the wall blocks his path and can knock him away.
Fire Flash Frost at Pantheon as he walks up, then hit him with Frostbite while he is chilled for much bigger damage.
Detonate Flash Frost early when Pantheon is close, so he is stunned before he can jump on you.
Do not hit Pantheon with Frostbite while he braces with Aegis Assault from the front; walk around or wait it out.
Keep your distance so Comet Spear has trouble reaching you, and take the early game to poke him down.
When Pantheon starts Grand Starfall, use the warning time to push or poke elsewhere, and keep Crystallize ready for when he lands.
Use Crystallize to wall off Pyke when he dashes in. It stops his movement, so he can't reach you easily.
Aim Flash Frost down the lane at Pyke. He has to hold still to charge Bone Skewer, so he is an easy target while he lines up his hook.
Follow Flash Frost with Frostbite on a chilled Pyke. The damage is doubled, and he is fragile.
Stay back from low-health allies and from your own low health. Death From Below can execute them, and Pyke teleports in for the kill.
When sharks circle under your feet, Pyke is hidden nearby in Ghostwater Dive. Back away from your ally and keep Crystallize ready.
Stay out of Senna's long attack range and make her walk into Glacial Storm. Her slowed, rooted approach is easy to punish.
Fire Flash Frost down the lane, then hit Frostbite on whoever was chilled by it. The combo deals double damage.
Put Crystallize in the way when Senna lines up Last Embrace. It is a projectile and the wall is terrain, so she must aim around it.
Stay behind your minions so Senna's Last Embrace hits them instead. Dodge it, because being rooted lets her team burst you.
Early on, your egg is hard to kill. Trade aggressively with Frostbite when Senna steps up to poke.
Fire Flash Frost down the lane, then hit them with Frostbite while they are chilled; the damage is doubled.
Stay out of long range of Beat Drop. Once you are slowed by anything, it roots you instead.
Use Crystallize to block the path of Beat Drop, because the wall is solid terrain. Place it before she casts, not after.
Be careful when Seraphine's Encore is ready. Charmed in lane, you can be killed, so keep your distance from her.
Hit her with Flash Frost when she is low on health. High Note hurts more as health drops, so she must stay healthy to trade.
Fire Flash Frost down the lane and follow with Frostbite while they are still chilled; it hits much harder against chilled targets.
Sona has little health early. Trade with Frostbite when her Hymn of Valor is on cooldown, so she can't hit back.
Recast Flash Frost early when an enemy is close to the ice, so the stun lands without needing max range.
Hold Crystallize to block the path when they close in, and keep it away from a Crescendo dive.
Stay out of Crescendo range at level 6 unless you can dodge; being stunned in lane lets their whole team hit you.
Stay out of Death Sentence range and watch for his cast to start; sidestep it, because the scythe is thin and easy to miss.
Fire Flash Frost, then hit them with Frostbite while they are chilled for much bigger damage.
Put Crystallize between you and Thresh when he looks to hook or engage; it blocks movement and his lantern can't be grabbed through it easily.
Trade when he is out of position or has missed Death Sentence, since it has a long cooldown.
Hold Flash Frost's recast to stun at the right moment when he commits or a hook ally rushes you.
